name: Follow-Up Sweep
office_task: Every evening, find what customers and suppliers still owe us that nobody chased, send the next capped follow-up on a consented channel, and hand any no or dead end to a named person.
systems_of_record: the register of open items on the business's own records (the job system's quotes and variations, or a sheet kept beside it), with its contact consents and written cadence

emits.write: an escalation on the open item naming the person who now owns it, for a no, a dispute, a stop-contacting-me, or the cadence cap reached with nothing back, carrying every touch so far
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the item id, the reason, the exception_owner and the touch history; no id back means nothing was raised and the item is not touched again that run
